description: Multi-tier: host disk full -> Postgres WAL fsync fails -> API HTTP 500
evidence_text: Node node-3 in namespace multi-agent: disk_usage probe reports /var/lib partition at 98% (df -hT, inode 41%). db_health probe: Postgres on postgres-0 write latency p99=18s with repeated 'could not fsync WAL' errors in journalctl. app_log: api-gateway HTTP 500 rate at 27% over the last 3 minutes, all on POST/write paths; GET paths still 200. This is a cross-tier cascade from host storage through the database to the API.
